en.title: Free Online Image Compressor | Reduce JPG, PNG and WebP
en.description: Choose a size in KB. Reduce JPG, PNG or WebP locally and download the result. No uploads.
en.lead: Reduce photos and images in KB, right in your browser.
en.note: JPG, PNG or WebP input · up to 25 MiB and 24 MP. Output up to 12 MP. Best effort: the exact size is not guaranteed. 1 KB here = 1024 bytes. Animated files become a still image. Processing stays on your device.
en.error: Could not process this file. Use JPG, PNG or WebP within the limits.
en.formatHelp: Smallest file compares real outputs while preserving transparency. Keep original format retains JPG, PNG or WebP; it does not guarantee lossless compression or a smaller file. PNG has no quality control. Dimensions may shrink in either mode.
